verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a single API token that validates all requests, plus OAuth 2.0 for building apps. Nothing documents scopes, permission limits, or least-privilege credentials that could be issued to an agent. Credential scoping is a fair question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence that Pipedrive delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
